S.FORM: panmwo:merge Ccquliq na Tayal qabax nya maki qalang Skikun qani, lalu qa Skikun qani ga cinlalu qa kinlhangan Nipun, baha hmcwan kintala kita qsliq na cquliq Nipun kmayal knkyan qani ga baqun calay ktayux cinbuyux na kayal qa qutux ryax qani, nanu mica Dkikun san naha qalang qani, qalang Skikun ga syugal knkyan naha qalang, maki qalang c'ux, maki qalng iyik, nya maki cka qalng qani ga baqan calay trahax, san naha Tayax cinlalu nya. blaq calay kayal nya ini kilux ro kheyak uyi, cinhtux qa ali na ruma qani ga mtasiq blaq niqun ro lbing calay baqun ccquliq qalang myan ana maki inu. Maki ppbiru bnran qani kmayal maha bawiq ki kolaw mlikuy Tayal kya, knerin hiya ga betunux ro blaq lungan naha, cwa maha kya ga knahu; bniqan na blaq kayal qalng qani. ana ccquliq ktayux naha cquliq qalng Skikun uyi ga mica kya san naha. tuqi qsya' ki rrhzyal giway rgrgyax qu qalang. squliq ka minkahul te hugal ga, blaq nha' mwah rgyax. basu' "basu'" qu spzyang glgang nha qalang musa' ana inu'. ungat kisya' nya'. Bnrwan qa galan cpung 四季部落(Qalang skikun)
S.PHON: panmwomerɣe [ʦ|ʨ][ʦ|ʨ]quliq na tajal qaβax nja maki qalaŋ [s|ɕ]kikun qani lalu qa [s|ɕ]kikun qani ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]inlalu qa kinlħaŋan nipun βaħa ħm[ʦ|ʨ]wan kintala kita q[s|ɕ]liq na [ʦ|ʨ]quliq nipun kmajal knkjan qani ɣa βaqun [ʦ|ʨ]alaj ktajux [ʦ|ʨ]inβujux na kajal qa qutux rjax qani nanu mi[ʦ|ʨ]a *kikun [s|ɕ]an naħa qalaŋ qani qalaŋ [s|ɕ]kikun ɣa [s|ɕ]juɣal knkjan naħa qalaŋ maki qalaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]ʔux maki qalŋ ijik nja maki [ʦ|ʨ]ka qalŋ qani ɣa βaqan [ʦ|ʨ]alaj traħax [s|ɕ]an naħa tajax [ʦ|ʨ]inlalu nja βlaq [ʦ|ʨ]alaj kajal nja ini kilux ro kħejak uji [ʦ|ʨ]inħtux qa ali na ruma qani ɣa mta[s|ɕ]iq βlaq niqun ro lβiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]alaj βaqun [ʦ|ʨ][ʦ|ʨ]quliq qalaŋ mjan ana maki inu maki ppβiru βnran qani kmajal maħa βawiq ki kolaw mlikuj tajal kja knerin ħija ɣa βetunux ro βlaq luŋan naħa [ʦ|ʨ]wa maħa kja ɣa knaħu βniqan na βlaq kajal qalŋ qani ana [ʦ|ʨ][ʦ|ʨ]quliq ktajux naħa [ʦ|ʨ]quliq qalŋ [s|ɕ]kikun uji ɣa mi[ʦ|ʨ]a kja [s|ɕ]an naħa tuqi q[s|ɕ]jaʔ ki rrħzjal ɣiwaj rɣrɣjax qu qalaŋ [s|ɕ]quliq ka minkaħul te ħuɣal ɣa βlaq nħaʔ mwaħ rɣjax βa[s|ɕ]uʔ βa[s|ɕ]uʔ qu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ ɣlɣaŋ nħa qalaŋ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ana inuʔ uŋat ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ njaʔ βnrwan qa ɣalan [ʦ|ʨ]puŋ ****qalaŋ [s|ɕ]kikun
